summary: Unblocks deterministic governance metadata validators encountered while preparing the backbone microservices PR by aligning ADR metadata/index generation, doc catalog coverage, glossary/placeholder registries, dependency-seam rationales, and layered-architecture/design-spec deferrals.
claim_boundary: This changeset claims local deterministic governance-validator unblock evidence for the touched metadata, registry, validator-code, dependency, design-spec, layered-architecture, and audit-chain coverage surfaces. It also claims ./bin/oya verify --ci-required passed locally after audit-chain coverage backfill. It does not claim live service deployment, production readiness, compliance certification, or remote GitHub Actions success.

findings: Kept fixes in existing validators and generated registries instead of adding parallel metadata systems.
Resolved duplicate ADR amendment records by deduplicating at ADR-index read time rather than hand-editing generated projections repeatedly.
Regenerated canonical ADR, glossary, placeholder, and design-spec evidence from validators so future bulk documentation growth remains mechanically checked.
Moved OpenTelemetry adapter dependencies to workspace dependencies to keep dependency-seam governance centralized.
Added doc_cli coverage for decision_owner frontmatter and duplicate base-vs-amendment ADR index behavior.
Added gate_cli coverage proving architecture scorecards are accepted as forensic ADR-citation surfaces.
The first post-evidence ./bin/oya verify --ci-required run exposed oya-vcs-admission audit-chain coverage gaps; the fix backfilled 46 evidence_emit rows and the admission gate then passed.
F3_adversarial.not_applicable_reason: No new validator lane or kernel public API was introduced; focused regression tests cover the exact previously failing branches.
F3_adversarial.diagnostic_asserted: ADR index metadata maps decision_owner to Owner, duplicate amendment files do not create extra ADR records, and architecture scorecard citations remain allowed as forensic surfaces.

findings: ADR owner metadata accepts the repository's decision_owner frontmatter vocabulary and generated projections preserve the human-facing Owner column.
Doc-catalog and README coverage now expose the AGENTS operating contract discoverably.
cargo fmt, cargo check, cargo clippy, and full workspace nextest passed locally after the metadata and dependency-seam fixes.
Generated registries are refreshed by their owning validators rather than hand-normalized.
Chose narrow validator/code metadata alignment over disabling lanes or weakening severity.
Chose explicit deferral registries for newly discovered design-spec and layered-architecture surfaces over claiming those follow-on surfaces are complete.
alternatives_named: Disable failing lanes or lower severity
Hand-edit generated outputs without changing generators/tests

F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: The selected path preserves deterministic gates and records bounded non-claims while making the current PR locally verifiable.
rejected_reasons: Disabling or weakening lanes would hide governance regressions.
Hand-edit-only outputs would drift on the next generator run.

findings: No auth, secret, payment, tenant-data, or runtime request-handling behavior changes are introduced by this slice.
Dependency-seam changes are constrained to workspace dependency declaration/rationale and a literal-token false-positive avoidance in a checker crate.
No hot-path runtime performance behavior is changed; validator reads add a small BTreeSet for ADR duplicate filtering in an offline documentation command.
Design-spec maturity evidence explicitly preserves the operational/compliance non-claim boundary: certifications and production readiness remain blocked until separate operational evidence exists.
Glossary, placeholder, ADR-citation, doc-catalog, and retired-vocabulary lanes pass locally for this metadata slice.
Changes are limited to metadata, registries, deterministic validator behavior, and workspace dependency declaration; each can be reverted without data migration.
Validator command outputs and evidence files capture counts for ADR, glossary, placeholder, design-spec, dependency-seam, and layered-architecture checks.
evidence/audit-chain.jsonl now contains evidence_emit rows for all branch-local backbone multispectrum evidence change_id values that were previously absent from the audit-chain text.
ADR index generation remains backward-compatible with existing frontmatter while accepting decision_owner and preserving standalone amendment ADRs.
Retired vocabulary and glossary acronym policy are aligned without reintroducing forbidden Foundry-fitness lane names.
AGENTS operating contract is cataloged and README-linked; ADR metadata and citations satisfy deterministic documentation lanes.
No retired implementation roots are recreated; updates remain in docs, crates, registry, and evidence surfaces.
Layered-architecture and design-spec deferrals are explicit registry entries instead of silent gaps.
Workspace OpenTelemetry dependencies and sqlx allowed-crate rationale are declared in canonical dependency governance files.
ADR-index duplicate filtering is deterministic by ADR number and amendment/base-file distinction.
Local non-ci gate mirror plus standalone fmt/check/clippy/nextest evidence are recorded; remote Actions budget blocking is not claimed as green.
